BJP Denies Discussion on Bharat Ratna for PM Modi

Union Minister J.P. Nadda stated that there has been no discussion within the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) regarding conferring the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, on Prime Minister Narendra Modi. This statement addresses speculation that had arisen concerning the potential for such an honor.
